Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring disclosure of nonoriginal repair parts.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the use of original equipment manufacturer crashparts for repair of motor vehicles; and adding a new section to chapter48.30 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.30 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText:
(1) As used in this section: (a) "Nonoriginal equipment manufacturer crash part" means areplacement for any of the nonmechanical sheet metal or plastic partsthat generally constitute the exterior of a motor vehicle, includinginner and outer panels, that was not made for or by the manufacturer ofthat motor vehicle. (b) "Original equipment manufacturer crash part" means areplacement part for any of the nonmechanical sheet metal or plasticparts that generally constitute the exterior of a motor vehicle,including inner and outer panels, that was manufactured by or for theoriginal manufacturer of that motor vehicle. (2) No insurance company may require the use of nonoriginalequipment manufacturer crash parts in the repair of a motor vehicle for p. 1 HB 2133a period of five years running from the year the motor vehicle wasmanufactured or while the vehicle is under manufacturer's warrantyunless the motor vehicle owner consents in writing at the time of therepair. If the motor vehicle owner consents to the use of nonoriginalequipment manufacturer crash parts, the insurer must specify on therepair estimate which parts are original equipment manufacturer crashparts and which parts are nonoriginal equipment manufacturer crashparts and must include with the estimate a disclosure documentcontaining the following information in no smaller than twelvepointtype: THIS ESTIMATE IS BASED UPON THE USE OF NONORIGINALEQUIPMENT MANUFACTURER CRASH PARTS THAT WERE MANUFACTUREDNEITHER BY THE ORIGINAL MANUFACTURER OR THE MOTOR VEHICLE NORBY A MANUFACTURER AUTHORIZED BY THE ORIGINAL MANUFACTURER OFTHE VEHICLE TO USE ITS NAME OR TRADEMARK. THE USE OF ANONORIGINAL EQUIPMENT MANUFACTURER CRASH PART INVALIDATES ANYREMAINING WARRANTY OF THE ORIGINAL PART IT REPLACES. THE ONLYWARRANTIES, IF ANY, COVERING NONORIGINAL EQUIPMENT MANUFACTURERCRASH PARTS ARE THOSE THAT MAY BE MADE BY THE MANUFACTURER ORDISTRIBUTOR OF THOSE PARTS. I UNDERSTAND THAT MY VEHICLE WILL BE REPAIRED USINGNONORIGINAL EQUIPMENT MANUFACTURER CRASH PARTS AS SPECIFIED INTHE REPAIR ESTIMATE, AND I AUTHORIZE THE REPAIR FACILITY TOINSTALL THOSE SPECIFIED PARTS.
